description: Aérodrome de Guyane en 2014 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Collectivité Territoriale de Guyane. Localisation des aérodromes de Guyane en 2014. Coverage: Collectivité Territoriale de Guyane. The publisher named on the listing is Collectivité Territoriale de Guyane. Its keywords include aerodrome, 2014, french-guiana, guyane-1, societe. The listing shows 2 download or service links in OGC:WFS, ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
